name: Translate article
description: Translate article content without changing meaning or structure.

presentation.description: Translate article content to the target language while preserving meaning and structure.
default_instructions: Translate the source article into the target language.
Do not change the meaning of the source.
Preserve Markdown structure and heading hierarchy when present.
Do not add commentary before or after the translation.
output_format: Translated article content only — no explanations.
notes: Prompt Markdown is the template sent to the model for this Hook.
